summary: British American Tobacco p.l.c. filed a Form 6-K on June 26, 2026, announcing an extension of its ongoing share buyback programme. The company entered an irrevocable, non-discretionary agreement with UBS AG London Branch to repurchase ordinary shares during a closed period from June 30 to July 29, 2026, ahead of half-year results. Repurchases will be made under shareholder authority granted at the 2026 AGM for up to 217,492,219 shares, within pre-set price parameters (max 105% of 5-day average or the higher of last trade/current bid). Shares will be cancelled to reduce capital. Enquiries are directed to Investor Relations.
